title: Forge-AutoCompiler C/C++ benchmark pilot manifest v2
description: The runnable five-case pilot manifest with frozen evidence instrumentation and control-plane topology.

git_commit_sha.description: A complete SHA-1 or SHA-256 Git object ID; symbolic or abbreviated refs are invalid.

safe_repository_url.description: An HTTPS repository URL without userinfo, query parameters, or a fragment.

model_endpoint.description: An HTTPS OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in /v1, without credentials or URL parameters.

relative_artifact_path.description: A POSIX path relative to /artifacts. Absolute, parent-traversal, and backslash paths are invalid.

environment.description: Only reviewed, non-secret process environment controls are permitted.
